# Request to send to the authentication server that includes.
# 1. The public key of the client.
# 2. The hash of the key.
# 3. The hash type used.
# 4. The username of the user.

curl -i -X POST -H "Content-Type:application/json" -d '{"publicKey": "", "hash": "7o2loGIME/fRN1uuvfs6FWWVDR3jMD/jLPuKnoH30b0=", "hashType": "SHA-256", "username": "pippo"}' http://localhost:8080/auth/syn
